title: ExportRequestPayload
description: Payload schema for the EXPORT_REQUEST intent. Routes through Privacy and Security review based on row count and sensitivity.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this export request.

requested_by.description: Agent or principal initiating the export.

data_source.description: Logical name of the data source (table, view, or service).

query_description.description: Human-readable description of what is being exported. Must be specific enough to evaluate scope.

filters.description: Filter criteria as key/value pairs. e.g. {"created_before": "2026-01-01", "region": "US"}.

estimated_rows.description: Expected row count. Above 10000 OR sensitivity=RESTRICTED triggers BLOCK_EXPORT unless explicitly approved.

sensitivity.description: Highest sensitivity classification of any field in the export.

fields.description: List of fields included in the export. Useful for Privacy review.

purpose.description: Business purpose for the export. Vague purposes trigger refusal.

lawful_basis.description: Legal basis for processing personal data, per GDPR Article 6 vocabulary. Required even when GDPR doesn't apply, for consistency.

destination.description: Where the export goes (e.g. 's3://bucket/path', 'email:user@example.com', 'sftp://...'). Cross-border destinations may require additional review.

retention_days.description: How long the exported file should exist before automatic deletion. 0 means destination handles retention.

third_party_recipient.description: If the export goes to a third party, document the DPA and recipient.

allOf.description: Exports of personal data must specify lawful basis (already required) AND have a destination + retention.

examples.query_description: All customers created before 2026-01-01 in US region for cohort retention analysis
examples.purpose: Q1 retention cohort analysis for product strategy review
